summary: Frontend-only follow-up verification pass. VISUAL BUG FIX CONFIRMED: app boots past splash within ~1s (no hang), login screen renders the bundled galaxy-bg.jpg photo background (nebula/stars clearly visible, not flat dark), and headings render in the locally-bundled Rajdhani display font (computed fontFamily=RajdhaniBold for both 'GROOVE SESH' and 'Welcome back'). Exact strings 'GROOVE SESH', 'MULTITRACK RECORDING STUDIO', 'Welcome back' all render correctly (no 'spelled wrong'). REGRESSION VERIFY PASSED: /session/[id] renders without red-screen (Metronome icon visible bottom-left), /paywall renders without red-screen (InfinityIcon/crown visible). SMOKE PASSED end-to-end: Sign Up on login → Flying-V home renders with JAM NOW + 5 fret buttons (New Session, My Sessions, Import, Tracks, Settings) → New Session creates and opens /session/{id} → Settings → Upgrade opens /paywall with Monthly $9.99 & Yearly $79.99 offerings → Sign Out returns to /login. Zero console errors, zero page errors. Only a minor missing testID on the session export icon (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: The share/export icon in the top-right of the session screen is visually present but has no discoverable testID (tried export-button/session-export/btn-export/export). Not user-facing; only affects automated testability.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): Add testID="export-button" to the session screen's export icon in app/session/[id].tsx so QA can automate the export flow.
No fixes required for this iteration — visual bug fix and both regressions are verified.
critical_code_review_comments: fonts.ts correctly uses require() to bundle Rajdhani + IBM Plex Sans TTFs locally — no remote font URLs.
src/components/ui.tsx uses require('../../assets/images/galaxy-bg.jpg') for GalaxyBackground — no remote image URL.
_layout.tsx gates render on fontsLoaded before AuthGate — prevents FOUT and 'spelled wrong' fallback rendering.
seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh test account via Sign Up UI (test_1790126944@example.com) — POST /api/auth/register succeeded and full authenticated flow was exercised.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual bug (fonts/background loaded from internet) is fully fixed via local bundling. Both prior red-screen regressions (Metronome/InfinityIcon phosphor imports) are fixed. All smoke flows work. Web preview flushes RevenueCat warning about fetch to e.revenue.cat — harmless on web. Pro entitlement is client-side; paywall UI renders both tiers correctly.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original 'spelled wrong / wrong font / wrong background color' report was that both the Rajdhani/IBM Plex Sans font files and the galaxy background image were being fetched from remote URLs at runtime. On networks where those URLs failed (or on-device), useFonts() would fall back to system fonts (making the display text look 'spelled wrong' because kerning/glyphs shifted) and the GalaxyBackground would render only the flat surface color. Mitigation: fonts are now referenced via require() in src/fonts.ts and the background via require() in src/components/ui.tsx (GALAXY_BG constant). Verified: computed fontFamily on live DOM = 'RajdhaniBold', and the img in GalaxyBackground now points to the bundled asset path (/assets/?unstable_path=./assets/images/galaxy-bg.jpg). Splash-to-login transition completes in ~1s.
